unit.why: A short anecdote: the Apter Rav shows great honour to the young R. Israel of Ruzhin, others are puzzled, and he justifies it with a midrash and an oath by his beard.
unit.boundary_note: Embedded in a homiletic compilation on honouring Torah scholars; the next division resumes the homiletic discussion.

stories.start_quote: בעת שהה״צ מאפטא זל״ה עשה כבוד
stories.end_quote: נשבע אני בזקני כי המדרש כוון עליו
stories.summary_en: The Apter Rav honours the young Ruzhiner, to the surprise of onlookers, and explains with a midrash about the unlearned righteous who sit with the Patriarchs, swearing by his beard that the midrash alludes to him.
